parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the doors and drawers, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and stabilizes the cabinet on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden hinged panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartment when opened and conceals contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden hinged panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the left side of the storage compartment and conceals items when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right drawer is a sliding storage compartment located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to store smaller items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along metal or wooden tracks.

parts.name: Drawer (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left drawer is a sliding storage compartment located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage for small items and can be pulled out for easy access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along metal or wooden tracks.
